title: leucas kishenensis
intro: Leucas kishenensis, commonly known as Kishan tulsi or Kishan basil, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine. The health benefits of Leucas kishenensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. Leucas kishenensis is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The plant contains bioactive compounds including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
